carrier_denial_notice: CLAIM DENIED ($0 PAYOUT): Aircraft equipment swap required by regional airspace congestion; passenger transported to destination in Economy (Code ATC-SWAP).
passenger_statement: Skies were clear in Dallas and Chicago. They swapped our widebody 787 for a tiny narrowbody, bumped me from my $1,280 Business Class seat into middle Economy, and still charged me $180 for my bags!
